judgements.justification: Without A's 9 (BBLZ) and B's 3 (wwer) both cores are 7, 7, 8; each single outlier moved its committee's mean (7.75 against 6.25) across the spotlight/poster line.
B's outlier wwer never answered the rebuttal, which showed TD3+BC postdated the deadline and others found the paper clear, so the 3 stood unrevised in B's mean.
B's two-sentence meta-review never mentions wwer's 3 or defends acceptance against it; nothing shows a detractor set aside while framing the decision.
No reviewer or area chair in either committee raised audience breadth or venue fit.
B's meta-review calls offline RL 'off-policy' but misreports no reviewer position or rebuttal content; A's reports a consensus the scores support.
Two of four reviewers engaged and revised in each committee (vwkm, oZUe in A; yZ2w, fkPB in B), so neither committee mostly left the rebuttal unanswered.
All confidences were 4 or 5 and no reviewer said they could not verify the results.
Neither committee split evenly; B had three accepts and one reject, and A four accepts.
The notes show the authors answering different questions in each committee, not giving conflicting numbers or accounts of the method.
BBLZ omitted the prior one-step work but gave no novelty verdict resting on it; B's novelty debate (yZ2w) cited the right papers.
A's spotlight is grounded in a stated spotlight consensus and a 7.75 mean; B's lower poster matches its scores.
No critic objected to the paper's framing from a neighbouring field's premises; wwer's misreading was inattention, not a different field's framing.
A's top scorer BBLZ also never joined the discussion, and B's most positive reviewer Uz96 gave an 8 with specific questions, so champion engagement does not separate the committees.
Neither committee judged the promised revisions too large for camera-ready.
A's area chair mentions internal discussion, but A had no split to settle and no off-record verdict is cited.

B's wwer (and fkPB) counted the lack of theory against an empirical paper that claims no theoretical results, feeding wwer's 'not technically sound' 3, while A valued the empirical contribution on its own terms.
wwer's 3 rested on novelty and soundness claims central to the contribution, not on a peripheral point, though it misread the method.
